## Summary

- AL REHMAN WELFARE PROJECT LTD (company number 07987818) is a private company limited by guarantee without share capital, incorporated on 13 March 2012 and now recorded as dissolved; its SIC code is 99000 and it files total exemption full accounts. `[profile]`
- The board shows 4 active officers out of 5 ever appointed, with no new appointments in the last 12 months. `[officers]`
- No charges have ever been registered, so under SEC-02 the security position is clean and a first-charge facility could in principle be offered subject to the other policies. `[SEC-02]`
- Filing conduct is poor: accounts to 31 March 2025 were filed 3 days late on 31 December 2025 and accounts to 31 March 2024 were filed 13 days late on 10 January 2025, with earlier filings up to 136 days late. `[AA filed 2025-12-31; AA filed 2025-01-10; AA filed 2021-05-13]`
- CON-03 treats these two late accounts filings in the last three years as a pattern rather than an isolated lapse, and refers the case irrespective of how short each delay was. `[CON-03; AA filed 2025-12-31; AA filed 2025-01-10]`
- CON-04 also refers because the most recent accounts are total exemption filings that disclose no turnover or profit; management accounts covering the last 12 months must be obtained before any decision. `[CON-04; AA filed 2025-12-31; profile]`
- Note the latest accounts are made up to 31 March 2025, some 18 months before the 30 September 2026 review date, so any management information requested should bridge that gap — and the dissolved status must be resolved before an approach is meaningful. `[computed; profile]`
